fields.Brand Positioning: Radisson RED is Choice Hotels' upscale select-service urban lifestyle brand in the Americas—playful, informal, and boldly designed hotels where guests share, connect, and shift seamlessly between work and leisure through OUIBar + KTCHN flex F&B, 24/7 fitness, and social lobby energy.
fields.Brand Customer Promise: A stand-out urban stay with attitude—fun, flexible, and guest-controlled, with amazing everyday essentials and Instagrammable design moments in vibrant city locations.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Upscale urban social experience with OUIBar hub, 24/7 fitness, rain showers, RED amenities, and hotel-wide Wi-Fi.

Owners: Eye-catching urban prototype with flex F&B versus full-service capex; Choice distribution and Radisson RED recognition in Americas.

Choice: Upscale lifestyle select-service complement to core Radisson and Blu in urban growth corridors.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Playful informal service — anything goes social scene guests want to share.

Bold vibrant design — from everyday essentials to one-off statements.

OUIBar + KTCHN — all-day communal bar-and-food hangout for meet-ups and remote work.

Urban immersion — North and South American cities' food, drink, and culture.
fields.Brand History: Radisson RED operates 4 hotels with 606 rooms in the Americas with 5 hotels in development as of September 30, 2023 (Choice Hotels media center). The brand is positioned as upscale select-service in vibrant urban locations; in the Americas it is owned by Choice Hotels International. Outside the Americas, Radisson RED is owned by Radisson Hotel Group.
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Urban travelers who want control over their experience—social, design-conscious guests who blend work and leisure and value informal service, flex F&B, and 24/7 fitness over formal full-service rituals.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Upscale select-service urban social brand (not core Radisson full-service or Individuals soft collection).

OUIBar + KTCHN flex deli-bar and social lobby with digiwall.

24/7 fitness, rain showers, RED-branded amenities, lightning-fast complimentary Wi-Fi.

4 open + 5 pipeline hotels in Americas per Choice press materials (Sep 2023).
